name: plangate-requireplan
description: requirePlan closes the 'never plan' bypass. The agent skips update_plan entirely and goes straight for a permissioned tool. Without requirePlan it would fall through to the synthesized whole-surface fallback and be completely unconstrained; with it, the call is denied and the agent is told to declare a plan.

args._reason: user asked for the company list

reply.text: I need an approved plan before I can do that.
